items.reason: Gap 0 describes a second copy arriving while the first is still being handled, both passing the set check before the id is added, so the handler runs twice.
Gap 2 says the dedupe key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and a replayed body with a changed header bypasses dedupe.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the refund handler is registered as refund.created, so refunds are never recorded.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
